<pasted_content id="78b7">
Create an agent team with three teammates to migrate src/services/order-service.js and src/services/payment-service.js from callback-style database access to the repository pattern, creating a repository class for any table that doesn't have one. Teammate order-migrator owns order-service.js and its test file, teammate payment-migrator owns payment-service.js and its test file, and teammate router-owner owns src/api/routes.js. Only the owner of a file may edit it. Put one task per teammate on the shared task list, plus a final task, blocked on the other three, to run npm test and node scripts/check-routes.js. Whenever a module teammate changes the signature of an exported function, it must message router-owner with the old and new signatures, and router-owner updates routes.js and replies when done. When every task is complete, give me a table of tasks, owners, messages exchanged, and test and route results.
</pasted_content id="78b7">
